text:
anya: FYI we got a new external model bundle to onboard (weights + tokenizer). Need intake + provenance checks before we can schedule bring-up.

mike_r: where is the bundle? S3 link and expected checksums?

anya: s3://redwood-models/incoming/external/partnerX/v1/
Please run sha256 on the .pt files and include tokenizer vocab checksum.
Sample commands:
```
sha256sum model.pt
python -c "import json; print(json.load(open('tokenizer.json'))['vocab_size'])"
```
Also attach model card, license, and source fingerprint.

sophia: quick Q on prioritization — is this high for production? we have quant experiments queued.

anya: Partner wants evaluation in the next 2 weeks. Priority = medium-high. If eval passes, we fast-track to quant bench.

kai: add these gating checks to the registry entry:
- artifact checksum (sha256)
- tokenizer version (huggingface style tag)
- model-card link
- license SPDX
- ingest user + KMS key id
- sample decode smoke tests (100 tokens)

jamal: I can open the registry PR once we have checksums. I'll also add RBAC for the S3 prefix.

mike_r: ran checksum, results:
```
sha256sum model.pt => 3b7f9a2c5d1e4f6a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e2c
sha256sum tokenizer.json => a1c5b9f3e7d2c4b6a8f0e1d2c3b4a5f6d7c8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d7f0
```
Uploading provenance blob to s3://redwood-models/provenance/partnerX/v1/provenance.json

artifact-bot: provenance blob uploaded and signed (kms: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789)

sophia: for the quant bench, nominate target bitwidths: int8, nf4, and a fp16 baseline. also need eval harness config and prompt set.

anya: noted. i'll prep prompt set + eval metrics (perplexity, rouge, instruction-following accuracy). Can we bump this to green if instruction-following >= 85% and latency < 120ms on p3.2x?

kai: agree on gates. add automatic fallback policy to smaller model variant if quant causes >2% accuracy drop vs baseline.

jamal: created PR #342 (registry entry + RBAC) — awaiting checksum blob link from mike.

mike_r: added provenance link to PR, and included the tokenizer vocab sha in metadata. Also left a note: tokenizer uses byte-level BPE, vocab_size=50265

anya: perfect. next steps: QA run (sophia), quant experiments (mike_r+kai), registry merge + access (jamal). I'll schedule standup sync on this on Tue.

sophia: :thumbsup: will run smoke tests tomorrow and post logs.

artifact-bot: smoke-test job queued (#smoke-598).
